title: Measure what linearSolver.reuseAnalyzedPattern gives in the performance models and the test models with sparse solvers
author: Claude-JG
description: Before making the reuse of the analyzed pattern of SparseLU the default: the wall time of every performance model and test model that uses EigenSparse, with the flag off and on (the faster of two runs each), and whether the results change.
releaseNotes: Measured: linearSolver.reuseAnalyzedPattern=True leaves the performance models with sparse solvers unchanged and saves 1.6 % on the test models with sparse solvers (at most 13 %); it stays off by default.
